title: Choose the reading list layout
question: Same notebook world as the study view (navy band, cool paper, hairline modules). Pick how the reading list is organised.

options.label: State board
options.thesis: The list as three columns: To read, Studying, Done. Studying means NOTES.md has entries beyond its header, so state comes from your files.
options.viewport: Cloth band with vault path, search and Add. A tag bar with counts. Three equal columns below; each item is a compact entry: type icon, title, domain, tags, and its E-entry and R-run counts.
options.risk: Columns waste width at 1,000 items, and 'Studying' is a derived state that INDEX.md doesn't store.

options.label: List with notebook peek
options.thesis: A dense list on the left. The selected item's notebook opens on the right: its entries, last runs and source, before you even open it.
options.viewport: Cloth band with search and Add. Left 55%: tag filter row, then pending items, then done. Right 45%: the selected item's title, source, its E-01… headings as a contents list, and its last three runs. Enter opens the study view.
options.risk: Two panes on the list screen as well as the study view can feel like the same screen twice.

options.label: Contents page
options.thesis: The vault read like a notebook's contents page: one numbered line per item in two ruled sections, Pending and Done, with entries, runs and source in aligned columns.
options.viewport: Cloth band with search and Add. A narrow tag rail on the left with counts. Main area: a sortable table, Pending first then a ruled Done section; columns: No., title, source, tags, entries, runs, last edited.
options.risk: Closest to the category default table; the notebook voice rests on the numbering and column rhythm.

regions.label: Pending: No. · title · source · tags · E · R
